title: Hawaii Revised Statutes, Chapter 398 — Family Leave

Chapter number and title corroborated from the DLIR Wage Standards Division FAQ page (https://labor.hawaii.gov/wsd/hawaii-family-leave/), headed 'Frequently Asked Questions on the Hawaii Family Leave Law (HFLL) / Chapter 398, Hawaii Revised Statutes', and citing operative section 398-3(b).
notes: in_force 'unclear' for the reason above. Wage replacement for non-work injury or sickness, including pregnancy, is a separate scheme: HRS ch. 392, Temporary Disability Insurance, corroborated from https://labor.hawaii.gov/dcd/home/about-tdi/. Hawaii mandates no holiday pay.
